blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine delegation joined a walkout when Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivered his speech at the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has confirmed. During the UNGA in New York City on Sept. 24, Philippine representatives joined other delegates who left the hall as Netanyahu delivered a 40-minute speech defending Israel’s actions in the Middle East. “The Philippines joined the walk out, in global solidarity for peace in the Middle East and the call for all parties to desist from unilateral actions that erode the conditions of peace and undermine the visibility […]...
